title: Sales Handling and Dealer Support
summary: Reviews in this topic focus on the sales process, with one smooth purchase experience contrasted against complaints about poor sale handling and unacceptable dealer support.

positive.summary: Positive feedback says the sale process went very smoothly.

negative.summary: Negative feedback describes badly handled sales interactions, unacceptable dealer support before and after purchase, and a lost sale tied to the experience.

limitations: The topic is based on only a few review fragments, so examples are limited.
One negative example mentions a lost sale but does not provide enough detail to specify the exact failure point.
